title: Chapter 63 Reentering The Long River Of Time And Space
content:
Chapter 63 Reentering The Long River Of Time And Space

In the hall, Lu Daosheng glanced at Gu Chen and the others indifferently, then smiled slightly.

"Go down."

Hearing this, the few people didn't dare to stay for a long time.

"We'll take a break."

Then several people hurriedly left.

On the way.

"An Xing, do you think the city lord was hiding his strength before?"

Gu Chen hesitated for a while and then asked.

Upon hearing this, An Xing was stunned. Thinking of the previous things, he immediately smiled bitterly: "The city lord was already unfathomable to me, and he still had to hide his strength. So whether we can live or not. ”

At this time, he was at the peak of the eighth level of the Earth Realm, and the distance between Lu Daosheng in the Heavenly Destiny Realm was also extremely far away.

"By the way, I heard that Brother Yun is training new recruits again."

At this time, An Xing continued to say.

Hearing this, Gu Chen's mouth twitched slightly.

"That war maniac,"

An Xing patted Gu Chen on the shoulder and smiled and said, "Don't worry about them. I think the city lord will not just be able to hold back this time."

Upon hearing this, Gu Chen's expression lit up.

"Oh? What do you mean?"

An Xing looked around carefully, then said, "The City Lord must have discovered something, so he chose to take action to shock those little girls hiding in the dark."

"I have sent many subordinates to infiltrate all over the world to inquire about information. I found that this world of spirits is not just as simple as it seems on the surface."

"There is a period of history that doesn't even have a trace of it."

Hearing this, Gu Chen's expression was also a little solemn.

"Did you tell the city lord all these?"

An Xing nodded, "That's natural, and I'm sure the city lord will do it soon,"

Speaking of this, An Xing didn't continue.

He just glanced at Gu Chen and then said goodbye.

In place, Gu Chen frowned.

An Xing suddenly told him these things, and that must have some profound meaning.

This guy has a very terrifying intelligence organization under his command.

Could it be that I want to prepare in advance?

With doubts, Gu Chen returned to his residence and began practicing day and night.

Inside the main hall.

At this time, what appeared in a light ball in front of Lu Daosheng's eyes was the scene where An Xing and Gu Chen just talked.

"This Anxing,"

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Lu Daosheng basically doesn't care much about these subordinates under his command, but he will occasionally help them improve their strength.

Otherwise, if the pace is too fast, he is afraid that his subordinates will not be able to catch up.

So he doesn't care about daily communication.

And now it seems that An Xing seems to have the idea of winning over Gu Chen.

In the deserted city.

Although Gu Chen has no one under his command, his status is definitely not low because he is the master of the city lord Lu Xue's daughter.

Anyone who sees it has to give face.

Lu Daosheng didn't care much about these things, as long as An Xing was loyal to Huangcheng and himself.

At this moment, I felt the entire world of spirits.

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

Now, there is no secret in his eyes.

It was like a daughter who took off her clothes and stood in front of him.

"It seems that there are two people who are not very honest."

Lu Daosheng looked at two places in the All Spirit Realm.

At this moment, the aura of both places was rising, and there was constant movement and stillness. Obviously something was about to come out.

And for a long time, those two places have been forbidden areas and no one dared to set foot on them.

At this moment, outside the deserted city, a bloody figure suddenly appeared in front of the gate of the deserted city.

It was the mysterious human powerhouse that Lu Daosheng beaten away before.

Seeing him, Huang Shou's eyelids twitched above the city wall.

What a joke, I dare to do this, is this guy so brave?

But the next moment, he was stunned again.

The mysterious man knelt directly in front of the city gate, his face full of blood, and said in a deep voice: "Genius General of Heaven, Ye Qing, please see the Lord of the Huangcheng City!"

This sound was extremely bright, mixed with the breath of the Heavenly Destiny Realm, and soon resounded throughout the entire world of all spirits.

Heavenly Warrior!

Most creatures were puzzled when they heard these four words.

What kind of force is this?

However, a very small number of ancient existences heard these four words, but they looked horrified on their faces.

Heaven!

I haven't heard the name of this force in many years.

In the world of all spirits today, there are actually strong people from the Heavenly Court!

How is this possible?

Didn’t the Heavenly Court have long been destroyed?

In the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

Lu Daosheng also heard this, but he didn't know it either.

But even so, he still did not let the man named Ye Qing enter the deserted city.

So, Ye Qing knelt outside the deserted city.

Seeing this scene, the ancient strong men almost fainted.

Is this Huangcheng City Lord so awesome?

That's the Heavenly Court!

And he is also a general in the Heavenly Court.

For a time, many powerful races ordered that from then on, when they saw the human race, they must be respectful.

The era of human race may come again.

"Tiange? Dipping sauce?"

Lu Daosheng murmured to himself, pondered for a moment, and Lu Daosheng suddenly thought of something.

Immediately, he saw him step directly into the void, and the next moment, an illusory long river of time and space appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

If you have any questions, history will tell him all.

Then Lu Daosheng stepped directly into the long river of time and space.

"How dare you! You dare to step into the long river of time and space without permission, don't you want to live?!"

As soon as he entered the long river of time and space, an angry shout suddenly sounded.

The next moment, an aura that was above the realm of destiny crushed towards Lu Daosheng.

This time, Lu Daosheng did not release his aura.

Because the long river of time and space could not withstand it. If the entire long river of time and space collapsed because of him, wouldn't the Wanling Realm be finished?

At this time, a figure suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"I'm talking to you, didn't you hear me? Dare to privately..."

At this point, he suddenly stopped talking and just stared at Lu Daosheng blankly.

Although Lu Daosheng did not actively release his aura, he still saw something with his eyesight.

"You..."

The middle-aged man looked at Lu Daosheng in front of him in horror, a little unbelievable.

Why would such a strong man appear in such a place?

"Not bad, from the Spacetime Palace?"

Lu Daosheng smiled faintly.

Hearing this, the middle-aged man was shocked and quickly bowed respectfully, "Time and Space Palace Yang Jiusheng greets the senior, may I know who the senior is?"

The middle-aged man looked at the other party in confusion, who exactly was the other party.

There shouldn't be a stronger existence than him in the Wanling Realm.

Looking at the middle-aged man's puzzled eyes, Lu Daosheng just shook his head faintly.

"It doesn't matter who I am. I came to the Spacetime River today just because I was a little confused and wanted to find out."

"As for you, just pretend you didn't see it, okay."

Lu Daosheng said friendly.

Hearing this, Yang Jiusheng hesitated.

"Senior, this, you should know the rules of my Spacetime Palace, the Spacetime River cannot, "

Before he finished speaking, a crystal stone appeared in his hand.

"Time, Spacetime Divine Crystal!"

Seeing this thing, Yang Jiusheng lost his voice directly.

"Is that enough?"

"Enough, enough, senior, do you need me to lead the way for you?"

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, "Just don't bother me."

"Okay, senior, please do as you please, I'll take my leave."

Then, Yang Jiusheng left here as if he was escaping.

There was a crazy excitement in his eyes.

Next, his fate might change because of that piece of time and space divine crystal.
